capabilities: Run a prompt note on the selected text
Send a change request to revise the preview
Replace the selection with the result
Pick prompts from a right-click submenu or fuzzy picker
disambiguation: Not a prompt library manager; it runs a chosen prompt file on the selected text and shows the rewrite in a preview.
extras: Desktop-only. Must be installed manually until it appears in the community plugin directory. Prompts are ordinary Markdown notes; YAML frontmatter in them is ignored. Only the configured Ollama endpoint receives the selected text and prompt.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to send selected text to a local model with a reusable prompt and check the result before it overwrites the text.

relations.evidence: Run one of your own prompt files on the text you have selected in Obsidian, using a local Ollama model.

summary: Runs a Markdown prompt note on the selected text through a local Ollama model and previews the rewrite before replacing the selection.
